title: Coastal loop out past the headland
body: Set off early to beat the wind and it mostly paid off — flat calm for the first hour, then a headwind the whole way back that turned the last climb into a proper effort.
Stopped at the usual bench for coffee from the flask. Worth doing again.

title: New bike lights arrived
body: Finally replaced the front light that's been dying halfway through every ride. First proper test tonight — should make the darker mornings less of a guessing game.

title: Slow one up the valley
body: Not a fast ride, just a needed one. Took the long way up the valley, stopped a lot, took photos of not much in particular.

title: Last day at Whitleigh
body: An unexpected bonus day at Whitleigh
